question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank No.4.
solution:
The correct answer is** 'Option 3'.** i.e. **'Having'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The correct option to fill in the blank No.4 is** 'having'.**
 
• In this case,** 'having'** is used as a present participle and it's often used to express completed actions that precede another point in time or event.
 
• **In the context** of the sentence,** 'having transferred'** indicates that Ronaldo's transfer from Manchester United to Real Madrid happened before the point in time when he became recognized as the most expensive player in football history.

Therefore, the** correct sentence** is: * 'Cristiano Ronaldo dos Santos Aveiro, born on February 5th, 1985 and commonly known as Cristiano Ronaldo, is a Portuguese footballer who plays as a forward for Spanish club Real Madrid and serves as captain of the Portuguese national team. Ronaldo currently holds the distinction of being the most expensive player in football history after **having** transferred to Real Madrid from Manchester United in a deal worth £80 million (€94m, US$132m). His contract with Real Madrid is believed to have made him the highest-paid 5. ______ player in the world.'*
